Who to watch

Dartmouth leaders (2026, through their last game)

  • Passing: #16 Grayson Saunier — 116/197, 1489 yds, 8 TD, 7 INT
  • Rushing: #8 Myles Craddock — 111 car, 503 yds, 4 TD
  • Receiving: #7 Ky'Dric Fisher — 27 rec, 436 yds, 4 TD
  • Tackles: #0 Steve Simpkins Jr. — 75
  • Sacks: #94 Roman Sosnovyy — 2

Dartmouth has the most Ivy League titles (22) and won four of the last six (Ivy League). This year's team is 4-5, 3-3, after losses at Princeton (21-14) and Cornell (20-14). Sammy McCorkle is in his fourth season as head coach, and Saturday is Dartmouth's Senior Day (Dartmouth Athletics). Quarterback Grayson Saunier also runs: 7 rushing touchdowns (ESPN box scores).

Brown leaders (2026, through their last game)

  • Passing: #15 James Murphy — 191/303, 2240 yds, 7 TD, 11 INT
  • Rushing: #2 Matt Childs — 126 car, 522 yds, 11 TD
  • Receiving: #2 Matt Childs — 45 rec, 479 yds, 1 TD
  • Tackles: #10 Max Malo — 109
  • Sacks: #0 Ike Odimegwu — 7.5

Brown has won four straight, 4-2 in the Ivy League and 6-3 overall, its first winning season since 2013 (Brown Athletics via BVM Sports). Last week Matt Childs ran for four touchdowns in a 28-20 win over Columbia. The defense is seventh in FCS in scoring defense at 17.1 points a game and leads the league in sacks; Max Malo leads FCS in tackles (Ivy League; ESPN). Harvard (5-1) has clinched a share of the title; Brown takes a share, its fifth Ivy title, with a win here and a Harvard loss to Yale later Saturday (Ivy League, Nov. 20).

The series: Dartmouth vs. Brown

All-time: Dartmouth leads 65-33-4 and has won eight of the last ten (Brown Athletics' preview, as indexed). Brown is looking for back-to-back wins over Dartmouth for the first time since 2007-10 (Brown Athletics via BVM Sports).

Last year, Nov. 22, 2025 at Brown Stadium — Brown 35, Dartmouth 28. Tied 28-28 in the fourth quarter, Alejandro Bello intercepted Grayson Saunier and ran it back 74 yards with 4:50 left. Murphy threw three touchdowns; Brown intercepted Saunier three times (ESPN).

Brown scores: 1st Matt Childs 19 yd pass from James Murphy; 2nd Childs 6 yd run; 2nd Jackson Delaney 21 yd pass from Murphy; 4th Solomon Miller 6 yd pass from Murphy; 4th Alejandro Bello 74 yd interception return.
Dartmouth scores: 1st Grayson O'Bara 13 yd pass from Grayson Saunier; 2nd Chris Corbo 35 yd pass from Saunier; 2nd Ky'Dric Fisher 20 yd pass from Saunier; 3rd Myles Craddock 3 yd run.

Game day

Buddy Teevens Stadium at Memorial Field

Built as a memorial to the 112 Dartmouth men who died in the First World War and completed in 1923. Seats about 11,000 (22,000 before renovation). FieldTurf since 2006. Renamed on Oct. 4, 2024 for Buddy Teevens '79, the winningest coach in Dartmouth history, who died in 2023 (Dartmouth; Wikipedia).

Saturday

  • 1 PM kickoff on ESPN+. Dartmouth's Senior Day.
  • Watch the other score: Harvard plays Yale at Fenway Park at 3:30 PM on ESPNU. Brown's share needs a Harvard loss (Ivy League).
  • Promotions, parking and tickets: check dartmouthsports.com before you go.
